process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before the command ran, with 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. This hit `gh pr view 234 --json ...`, `git diff b98e363e570950d767f01e0eda328c372b256f3e..HEAD --stat` and a bare `git rev-parse HEAD`. The bubblewrap sandbox can't start on this runner, so the PR diff, its file list, its intent and the head SHA could not be read. The change could not be identified, so the provenance and freshness checks could not run.

No reviewers were spawned. Subagents use the same broken Bash sandbox, so they could not fetch `gh pr diff 234` or `git diff <merge_base>..HEAD` either. A review of files guessed without the diff would not be grounded. PR #234 was NOT reviewed. Re-run once the runner allows the sandbox's user namespace (CAP_SYS_ADMIN / unprivileged userns), or once the sandbox is set up so Bash can run.

incomplete_reason: Not reviewed: no reviewer was spawned; re-run
